source.title: 阿瓦隆忘记表水，自有大儒为我辩经

interval.rationale: Full feature. 0-247 s is a teaser ('本期导视' + '正片跳转至4分07秒' = 247 s) replaying later clips. The client's own caption at 1797.4 s reads '任务成功，2号刺客决定发动刺杀' — it names the assassin — and from 1802 s the speaker label reads 刺杀梅林讨论 (the evil team picking a target), then 赛后. live_game_interval therefore ends at 1797.3 s, just after the bare '任务成功' caption (on screen 1796.0-1797.2 s) and before the leaked variant. Extraction runs to 1810 s so a reviewer can see the switch in the evidence instead of taking the boundary on trust. Media is the verified 1080p HEVC stream (sources/verify.BV1kr876AEE1.hevc.json).

basis.player_count: board vote strips run 1-10; roster panel lists seats 1-10
basis.mission_team_sizes: board headers state 第2轮·需要4名队员, 第3轮·需要4名队员, 第4轮·需要5名队员. Mission 1's own header is clipped above the frame top, but both of its proposals and the team that executed it are 3 seats, so 3 is read off the rows themselves. Mission 5 was never reached and its size is NOT stated anywhere, so it is not listed.
basis.proposal_limit: board rows read '第1/3次组队', '第2/3次组队'
basis.final_proposal_forced: observed: mission 2's third row reads '必做轮组队 / 必做轮' and carries no vote strip at all
basis.fails_required: PARTLY observed and therefore NOT asserted to a model. Mission 3 failed with exactly 1 fail card out of 4, so round 3's threshold is 1; rounds 1, 2 and 4 each ran with 0 fail cards, which says nothing about their threshold. The listed [1,1,1,2] is the standard 10-player rule and is listed in `unverified` so the rendered input omits it.
basis.lady_of_the_lake: no 湖中仙女/湖中女神 row or caption anywhere in the feature; re-checked on the full extraction
basis.role_composition: from the private spectator roster, which lists 莫德雷德/莫甘娜/刺客/奥伯伦 as the four evil roles plus 梅林, 派西维尔 and 4 忠臣 — the standard 10-player set with Oberon. Composition is common knowledge at the table; who holds what is not, and stays private.
